title: 第一卷 · 霓虹失名者 / 第一章 1.2 地下末班车
description: 原创像素冒险 · 四六级常见词汇与推断练习 · 3 道分段听力题
source: 原创剧情、原创四六级听力风格题，不是考试原文。
audioLabel: 自然英文神经网络配音：星遥 Michelle / 陆川 Brian / 旁白 Christopher / 系统 Guy · 原创非考试原音
itemScene: 废弃站台的身份闸机仍在追踪星遥。她能修好列车，却无法同时遮蔽沿线的巡逻信号。万象系统提示：部署信号干扰器，建立一次安全通行窗口。
ending: 本节行动结果已记录。前往主线地图查看路线，或重新闯关尝试另一种道具选择。
questionNote: 每八句一次听力检查，共三题；首次无字幕，解析在节末显示。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: The last train stands beneath the city, its windows dark and its doors locked.
lines.translation: 末班列车停在城市地下，车窗漆黑，车门紧锁。

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: This line closed three years ago. The company said it was no longer profitable.
lines.translation: 这条线路三年前停运。公司说它已经无法盈利。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Then why are the security gates still connected to the central network?
lines.translation: 那为什么安检闸机还连着中央网络？

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: They track movement, not passengers. People without official records still need somewhere to go.
lines.translation: 它们追踪移动，而不是乘客。没有正式记录的人仍然需要去处。

lines.speaker: 万象系统
lines.text: Signal jammer deployed. Local surveillance will receive an empty platform image.
lines.translation: 信号干扰器已部署。本地监控将接收到空站台影像。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: So the cameras cannot identify us. Can we board the train now?
lines.translation: 所以摄像头无法识别我们。现在能上车了吗？

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: Not yet. The main battery is damaged, but the emergency supply may still work.
lines.translation: 还不行。主电池损坏了，不过应急电源可能还可以用。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: You handle the power. I will keep the patrol signal away from this station.
lines.translation: 你处理电源，我让巡逻信号远离这座车站。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: Xingyao opens a metal panel. A thin blue light appears beneath her fingers.
lines.translation: 星遥打开金属面板。她的指尖下亮起细细的蓝光。

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: The emergency battery has enough energy for one journey, provided we reduce the load.
lines.translation: 应急电池足够跑一趟，前提是减轻负载。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Would turning off the lights help? We do not need the whole carriage illuminated.
lines.translation: 关灯有用吗？我们不需要照亮整节车厢。

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: Yes, but heating consumes much more power. We should disconnect it first.
lines.translation: 有用，但供暖消耗的电更多。应该先切断供暖。

lines.speaker: 万象系统
lines.text: Heating disabled. Estimated travel range has increased by forty percent.
lines.translation: 供暖已关闭。预计行驶距离增加百分之四十。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: It will be cold. Take my jacket if you need it.
lines.translation: 会很冷。如果需要，你可以披上我的外套。

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: Keep it. You have never spent a night underground. I can manage the temperature.
lines.translation: 自己留着。你没在地下过过夜，我能应付这种温度。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: She looks away, but moves her bag so that there is a seat beside her.
lines.translation: 她移开目光，却挪开了包，给身边留出一个座位。

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: The shelter is beyond the next junction. We must take the maintenance tunnel.
lines.translation: 避难所在下一个岔口后面。我们必须走维修隧道。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: The public route looks shorter. Why not follow that one?
lines.translation: 公共线路看起来更短。为什么不走那条？

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: Its final gate checks every passenger against the company database. Your name would be missing.
lines.translation: 它的最后一道闸机会核对每位乘客的公司数据库记录。那里找不到你的名字。

lines.speaker: 万象系统
lines.text: Alternative route confirmed. The maintenance tunnel has no identity checkpoint.
lines.translation: 替代路线已确认。维修隧道没有身份检查点。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: You knew this route before we met. Have you helped other people escape?
lines.translation: 在遇见我之前，你就知道这条路。你帮过其他人逃走吗？

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: My father designed these tunnels. He disappeared after questioning the identity system.
lines.translation: 这些隧道是我父亲设计的。他质疑身份系统后就失踪了。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Then we are not simply hiding. We are going to find out what happened to him.
lines.translation: 那我们就不只是躲起来。我们要查清他究竟发生了什么。

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: There is an archive near the shelter. If his original reports survived, we may finally have evidence.
lines.translation: 避难所附近有座档案室。如果他的原始报告还在，我们也许终于能找到证据。

questions.prompt: Why does Xingyao not board the train immediately?
options: The cameras are still identifying them.
questions.explanation: 干扰器已遮蔽摄像头，但星遥接着说主电池损坏，所以仍不能立刻上车。

questions.prompt: What do they disconnect first to save energy?
questions.explanation: 星遥明确说供暖耗电更多，应该先断开。不要被陆川提出的关灯建议干扰。

questions.prompt: Why do they choose the maintenance tunnel?
options: It leads directly to her father.
It is the shortest public route.
questions.explanation: 公共线路末端会核对身份，维修隧道没有身份检查点，适合没有记录的陆川。
